藏品名称_EN: bodhisattva guanyin of the lion's roar
描述_EN: the poised calm of the buddhist deity guanyin (the chinese goddess of mercy) is contrasted with the liveliness of the little lion leaping up playfully. while it is very difficult to date small carvings of this type in steatite, it closely resembles white ceramic figures of guanyin from dehua (in fujian province), and hence possibly was made between about 1650 and 1750. this sculpture is a small masterpiece of serene composition.
描述_ZN: 佛教的观音菩萨（中国的慈悲女神）的沉着冷静与小狮子的活泼俏皮形成对比。 虽然很难确定这类硬玉小雕的年代，但它与福建德化的白陶观音非常相似，因此可能是在1650年至1750年间制作的。 这个雕塑是一个宁静构图的小杰作。
